description_zh: 创建一个一致性复制组
kebab_example: aliyun ebs create-disk-replica-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --source-zone-id cn-beijing-f --destination-region-id cn-shanghai --destination-zone-id cn-shanghai-e --group-name myreplicagrouptest --description This_is_description. --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --rpo 900 --bandwidth 5 --resource-group-id rg-acfmvs0000000 --tag Value=tag-value Key=tag-key --enable-rtc true --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDiskReplicaGroup

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the replication pair-consistent group resides. This is the same as the region of the production site
parameters.help_zh: 一致性复制组所属的地域ID，与生产站点所属的地域相同
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the zone where the production site is located
parameters.help_zh: 生产站点所属的可用区ID
parameters.name: source_zone_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the disaster recovery site is located
parameters.name: destination_region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the zone where the disaster recovery site is located
parameters.help_zh: 灾备站点所属的可用区ID
parameters.name: destination_zone_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the replication pair-consistent group. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character, and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. It can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 一致性复制组的名称。长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: group_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the replication pair-consistent group. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh: 一致性组的描述信息。长度为2~256个英文或中文字符，不能以`http:/`/或`https://`开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value from your client for this parameter. The \`ClientToken\` parameter value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The recovery point objective (RPO) of the replication pair-consistent group, in seconds. The only supported value is 900
parameters.help_zh: 一致性组设定的RPO值，单位：秒。当前仅支持900秒
parameters.name: rpo

parameters.help_en:
The bandwidth in Kbps.

> This parameter is not yet available
parameters.help_zh:
带宽值，单位：Kbps。
>该参数暂未开放使用
parameters.name: bandwidth

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the replication pair-consistent group belongs
parameters.help_zh: 一致性复制组所在的企业资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

element_fields.help_zh: 一致性复制组的标签值
element_fields.name: value

element_fields.help_zh: 一致性复制组的标签键
element_fields.name: key

parameters.help_en: The tags to add to the resource. You can add up to 20 tags
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表，最多包含20个子项
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable replication time control (RTC). Valid values:

- false: Disable RTC.

- true: Enable RTC.

Default value: false.

> If you set this parameter to true, RTC is enabled for the replication pair-consistent group. RTC is also enabled for all asynchronous replication pairs that are added to the group
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启复制时间控制（RTC）。取值范围：

- false：关闭。
- true：开启。

默认值：false。

> 如果设置为ture，表示一致性组开启复制时间控制（RTC），加入该一致性组的异步复制对均开启RTC
parameters.name: enable_rtc
